script_text: Stop, Pisces! A relationship reset demands honesty; pretending everything is fine will backfire. Using whole-sign houses, Neptune, your water-sign ruler, occupies the 11th House, where imagined futures can seem deceptively polished. The Moon in Pisces is sextile Jupiter in Cancer, favoring grounded conversations about pay. Saturn in the 6th House rewards discipline; the Sun now opposes Pisces in the 7th House, pushing reciprocity to center stage. If single, attract someone candid and dependable rather than dramatic and elusive. If partnered, keep money, boundaries, and unspoken commitments clear. Your 6th House favors reviewing payroll, contracts, and recurring expenses. In the 10th House, favor a long-term offer over a flashy promise, and negotiate your salary in writing. Avoid lending your emotional energy to someone who refuses direct answers; firm limits are your Water-element gift. Subscribe so you don’t miss what unfolds tomorrow.
